fact: 1926年起圣保罗咖啡研究所（Instituto de Café）从「被动托市」转为「主动抬价」：通过加大扣留（retention）库存、限制运往桑托斯港的配额，主动推高国际市场咖啡价格。这是限产保价政策的升级。

sources.title: Wikipedia Republished, Brazilian coffee cycle（Coffee Institute 政策）
sources.quote: From 1926 on, the Institute even started to increase the prices of the product in the international market by increasing the retention of the commodity. This strategy was not successful either – and was further aggravated by the beginning of the great economic crisis, the Great Depression.

sources.title: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Brazil's Coffee Industry（1925—1926年控制机制完善）
sources.quote: During 1925 and 1926, mechanisms for control were perfected. Port entries were continued in modified and more flexible forms.

fact: 1926年9月咖啡价格约22美分/磅，此后下跌，1927年年中跌至16美分/磅；研究所以500万英镑的一年期贷款托市收购，1928年才使年均价格回到23美分。1926年正是「限产保价」与市场价格下行赛跑的起点。

sources.title: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Brazil's Coffee Industry
sources.quote: The newly created Institute received its first real test with the 1927-28 bumper crop of 27.6 million bags. Through heavy buying made possible by a 1-year loan of 5 million pounds sterling, prices, which had dropped from 22 cents per pound in September 1926 to 16 cents in mid-1927, recovered to an average of 23 cents a pound in 1928.

fact: 华盛顿·路易斯（Washington Luís）1926年就任总统（1926—30），其纲领以财政整顿、外贸平衡、取得黄金以最终实行金本位与新货币（cruzeiro）为核心；咖啡价格支持被视为该稳定计划的必要条件。种园主怀疑「咖啡保护」的借款实为支撑milréis（雷亚尔旧币）汇率，而非保护种植者利益。

sources.title: Latin American Research Review, Coffee Planters, Politics, and Development in Brazil
sources.quote: During and after 1926, planters became resentful of even more ambitious policies for fiscal and monetary reform announced by the new president, the PRP's Washington Luís Pereira de Sousa. Planter suspicions that coffee policies reflected the priorities of the new stabilization plan were essentially correct. Monetary reform leading to the adoption of the gold standard and a new currency to be known as the cruzeiro was central to Washington Luís's program. ... Coffee price supports were deemed essential for the stabilization plan to work.

fact: 研究所的管制工具在1926年成型：对内地运往桑托斯的装运实行配额（port entries/quotas）、设定最低价、扣留剩余库存、以运输税与外债融资。表注口径显示配额登记含「expurgo配额」（低等级销毁/剔除的配额，占登记总量10%）——即通过剔除低质货来保价。外来经营者只能在配额与商号网络的框架内活动。

sources.title: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Brazil's Coffee Industry（配额登记表注与控制机制）
sources.quote: Registrations include all coffee destined for sale in the seaport markets. 2 Includes the expurgo quota of 10 percent of total registrations. ... Shipments to ports were limited and a system of establishing minimum coffee prices was inaugurated.

sources.title: Latin American Research Review, Coffee Planters, Politics, and Development in Brazil（研究所的管制权与种园主不满）
sources.quote: Because the Coffee Institute was granted extensive powers to regulate the coffee economy and establish quotas to limit shipments to the port of Santos from the interior, the government was in a position to determine the fate of regions and producers. ... Planter opposition to such a policy suggests that it was adopted to maximize revenues in hard foreign currencies.

fact: 限产保价的物流基础是仓储与出口走廊：1924年建成的11座调节仓库（总容量约350万袋）承担扣留库存职能，咖啡经铁路运往桑托斯港出口；出口套利的关键在于「何时放库存、何时扣」——研究所1927年大丰收时托市收购、1928年歉收时放库存，验证了仓储的跨期调节功能。

sources.title: 上報《飆漲的咖啡價格》（1924年仓库体系）
sources.quote: 一九二四年,"咖啡保護計畫"在全國擴大發展,建立了十一個倉庫能夠存放三百五十萬袋,約莫五億磅咖啡

sources.title: Harrell's History, The Great Depression and the Americas 1929-39（研究所的跨期调节）
sources.quote: In 1927, Brazil produced an all-time high of 27 million bags of coffee and as world prices began to fall, the institute bought coffee and prevented a substantial decrease in the price. Then, in 1928, when the coffee crop was small, the stocks they had purchased were placed on the market and not only did prices hold, but there were substantial reserves of coffee to be sold.

fact: 咖啡经济的分配格局未变：出口占国家收入约70%，外债约9亿美元、年偿约1.75亿美元；保价收益偏向大种植园主，小农与农业工人分享有限。1926年华盛顿·路易斯的稳定计划把财政整顿优先于种植者利益，种园主协会与政府的裂痕在1926年后持续扩大。

sources.title: Harrell's History, The Great Depression and the Americas 1929-39（外债与偿付）
sources.quote: On the eve of the Depression, Brazil's foreign debt was $900 million and the government paid out approximately $175 million per year in repayment of loans, relying on the profits of the export trade to make their annual payments.

fact: 1926年前后巴西咖啡带的种植园劳动力高度依赖移民（意大利、西班牙、日本等），种植园债务束缚（colonato）与劳动条件问题长期存在；外来经营者进入种植园腹地须关注劳动纠纷、地方治安与热带疾病（黄热病、疟疾）风险。本条只记录风险面存在，具体疫情数据未取得。

sources.title: Latin American Research Review, Coffee Planters, Politics, and Development in Brazil（种植园体系与社会矛盾）
sources.quote: The growth of a smallholding system in coffee meant that the market was approaching saturation. The strains and conflicts between various producers and regions had been effectively thrust into the commercial arena
